descriptions.routine_analysis: Complexity 1 to 2 with medium/high confidence and no critical risk or mandatory specialist flags routes to Routine Analysis.
descriptions.borderline_complexity_3: Complexity 3 evaluates material flags, unresolved status, repeat-contact risk, and confidence to route to either Routine or Specialist Analysis.
descriptions.specialist_analysis: Complexity 4 to 5, low confidence, needs_deeper_analysis, or any dispute, fraud, compliance, escalation, threat, self-harm, or severe customer distress indicator triggers Specialist Analysis.
descriptions.challenger_trigger: Critical-risk flags (fraud, compliance, threat, self-harm), low specialist confidence, or forced challenger evaluation require independent Challenger validation.
